xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2499: feat(dashboard): unify the three issue views into one progressive-density Issue View (rail · cockpit · console)

plan.title: feat(dashboard): unify the three issue views into one progressive-density Issue View (rail · cockpit · console)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PAN-2487 drift incident (spinner/ship row added twice)
PAN-2037 start-agent CTA (absorbed by start-agent-cta bead)

narratives.Problem: One issue's live pipeline state renders in three independently built components — Console (drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx), Cockpit (Stage/cockpit/IssueMissionControl.tsx + AgentsLane.tsx), and Rail (CommandDeck/ProjectTree/FeatureItem.tsx + SessionNode.tsx, 4,001 lines total) — that read the same hooks/store but each re-implement the agent row, ship progress, verification gates, and beads panel. Drift is structural: the active-node spinner and Ship-door row were each added twice (PAN-2487, PAN-2493), the ★ Active-Agent panel exists only in the Console, and when PAN-2229 sat troubled there was no recovery button on any surface.
narratives.Proposal: One data model + one component family at three densities. Build useIssueView(issueId) → IssueViewModel composed strictly from the existing hooks (ZoneCOverviewTabs/queries.ts) + Zustand store (D2: no new endpoint/state). Extract a shared kit under components/issue-view/ (AgentStepRow, ShipProgress, VerificationGates, BeadsPanel, ActiveAgentPanel, StartAgentCta), one cluster per bead with old duplicates deleted in the same bead (D1). Compose them in <IssueView density="rail|cockpit|console"> driven by a declarative DENSITY_SECTIONS map (D3); the three shells become thin adapters. A no-loss test locked to the mockup inventory gates every bead (FR-0). Finish with rail expand-in-place (FR-8) and the needs-you recovery CTA that clears troubled/paused gates server-side and starts the agent in one click (FR-9).
narratives.NonGoals:
- WI-8 (retiring the bespoke Console/Cockpit shells) is deferred out of this issue; it needs operator sign-off on the new surface first (PRD marks it OPTIONAL). All three entry points keep working (D5).
- No new API endpoints and no new server-side state for the view-model (D2); a datum needing a new endpoint is a separate issue.
- No removal of the "open in a Command Deck tab" navigation path — it is preserved during this issue (removal belongs to the deferred WI-8/Phase 5).
- No redesign of section content or visual refresh beyond the pan-style-guide; this issue relocates and unifies, it does not restyle.
- No changes to the review convoy, verification gate, or merge pipeline behavior — UI-side unification only, except the single clearGates option on the existing start-agent route.
- No section listed in the mockup no-loss inventory may be dropped — relocation only.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-0 gate lands first as a manifest-completeness test (every inventory section maps to a declared component home), upgraded to render-based data-section assertions in the issue-view-wrapper bead.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-0 says the gate exists from Phase 1, but its literal assertion target (<IssueView> densities) does not exist until WI-6; a manifest test enforces the surface-lock from day one without asserting against components that do not exist yet.

autoDecisions.summary: WI-8 (retire shells) excluded from this plan's beads and recorded as a NonGoal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD marks WI-8 'OPTIONAL, deferrable' and conditions it on the operator confirming the new surface feels right — that confirmation cannot happen inside this issue's pipeline run.

autoDecisions.summary: WI-4 split into two beads (VerificationGates, BeadsPanel) and WI-9 split into three (server clearGates, StartAgentCta at IssueView densities, kanban/fleet chip adoption); other WIs map 1:1 to beads.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each split piece is independently reviewable and testable; PRD D1 only requires extract+adopt+delete atomicity per cluster, which each split bead preserves.

autoDecisions.summary: ReviewPolicyControl (PAN-1874) added to the no-loss manifest with a cockpit+console home in DENSITY_SECTIONS.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue comment (2026-07-11) mandates it survive unification; verified 2026-07-13 it renders in ReviewPolicyControl.tsx via SessionView/IssueHeader.tsx and IssueMissionControl.tsx.

autoDecisions.summary: Added a docs bead (docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md + codebase-map architecture note) not present in the PRD's work items.
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo PRD-authoring rule requires a documentation work item for any changed surface; the PRD itself omitted one.

autoDecisions.summary: useIssueView bead gets requiresInspection:true with inspectionDepth:deep; issue-view-wrapper gets requiresInspection:true with fast depth; all other beads false.
autoDecisions.rationale: The view-model is the cross-cutting foundation every subsequent bead consumes (MIN-796-class risk); the DENSITY_SECTIONS wrapper is the architectural decision the interaction and CTA beads build on. The rest are leaf extractions verified by their own tests and the no-loss gate.
